title: quick-deploy-server-type
description: The server type a Quick Deploy of a stack provisions, and the rates it is priced at. Stacker's part of the contract.
_notes: A Quick Deploy clones the stack's baked snapshot, whose disk is the disk of the build box it was baked on, so the snapshot's server type is the type a clone of that stack uses.
The bake records the build box's server type on the snapshot. A snapshot baked before that has none, and the caller's default type applies.
POST /api/v1/deploy/validate returns quick_deploy: that server type and the daily rate and monthly cap of every server type - the rates the clone bills.

server_type.description: server type the stack's latest healthy snapshot was baked on; null when unknown
